color-system.twistDescription: Copied verbatim — no twist applied per spec. pageBackground #f4f4f4, luminance 244 (qualifies as light register).

type-system.twistDescription: Twist C: Heading font weight shifted +200 (400 → 600) for h2 condensed display. All proprietary fonts replaced with Google Fonts CDN: interstate-condensed → Barlow Condensed, interstate → Barlow, Lexend Giga → Barlow Condensed. Letter-spacing 0.02em added to heading cssVars.

motion-system.twistDescription: Twist A: All transition and animation durations scaled ×1.5 for a more languid, deliberate pacing (0.4s→0.6s, 0.5s→0.75s, 0.6s→0.9s, 0.2s→0.3s). No color values changed.

grid-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Container maxWidth tightened 15% (950px → 808px) for a more editorial, narrow-column feel. No color values changed.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist C: Hero padding emphasized ×1.5 (110px → 165px) for amplified above-fold presence. All other spacing unchanged. No color values changed.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist E: Focus state enhancement — outlineWidth set to 2px on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, navigation). No color values changed.

nav-system.twistDescription: Twist D: Letter spacing 0.08em added to nav link typography. Font family updated to Barlow (consistent with type system). No color values changed.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Twist A (Kinetic shift): Scroll interaction section rewritten to emphasize tempo, movement, and deliberate pacing — analytical language shifted toward kinetic/temporal description. concept_by_video.md generated with 3 video placements: product-ambient.mp4 (10s workspace pan), dark-section-ambient.mp4 (10s surface drift), testimonial-bg.mp4 (5s gradient field).

productConcept.name: Torq
productConcept.description: Computational load, stress, and fatigue simulation for composite material engineers. Compliance-ready outputs from the first simulation run.
productConcept.audience: Structural, aerospace, and advanced materials engineers

checkA_colorContrast.notes: pageBackground #f4f4f4 (luminance 244), bodyText #201d1d (luminance ~31). Contrast passes — light bg, dark text. Nav: background #1c1a1a (luminance ~28), text #f4f4f4 (luminance 244). All pairs have sufficient contrast.

checkB_motionInteractionCoherence.notes: Hover transition durations (0.15s in interaction-states) vs motion primary durations (0.6–0.9s). 0.15s vs 0.6s = 4× ratio — within the 5× threshold. Hover is micro-interaction, motion is scroll/section — different purposes, structurally valid.
